Container.Name: gpu-tuner
Container.Overview: NVIDIA GPU monitoring, power limits, fan curves and clock caps for Unraid. Requires the NVIDIA Driver plugin and a compatible GPU. Set the WebUI URL to http://YOUR-UNRAID-IP:8765 and supply an initial password of 12–1024 characters. Settings and credentials persist in appdata. GPU control requires SYS_ADMIN; privileged mode is not required. Use on a trusted LAN.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent GPU settings and WebUI credentials. Use a dedicated directory; do not share with another running GPU Tuner instance.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: WebUI port on the Unraid host. Match this port in WebUI URL.

Config.Name: WebUI URL
Config.Description: Required: exact browser URL, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8765. Use your Unraid IP and the host WebUI port. No path. This permits the Host and Origin used by your browser.

Config.Name: Initial WebUI Password
Config.Description: First install only: 12–1024 characters. Ignored once a password hash exists. Required for installation. After successful login, enable Advanced View, remove this variable and Apply to remove the plaintext from Docker configuration and the saved template.
